title: Neuron Activation
blurb: Sci-fi hum, brain lights up, higher reasoning leaves the building. The monke neuron activation meme is the internet's most honest joke about cognition: sometimes there is no thought process at all, just a stimulus and a response, and pretending otherwise is flattery. Banana? Activation. Ball? Activation. Somebody says the name of your hometown in a film? Full activation. Play it when anybody, very much including yourself, responds to pure stimulus in place of sense. Simple creature, simple pleasures, immediate and total engagement.
origin: From the 'monke neuron activation' meme about primal brain responses.
